verdict: Bristol Myers Squibb grew revenue 7% to $13.1B as Eliquis and its newer medicines outgrew generic losses, but $1.6B of charges for buying drug research rights held GAAP EPS to $1.05.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: Revenue was $13.1B, vs $12.2B a year ago

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: vs $1.08 a year ago; non-GAAP EPS was $1.35

segments.name: Growth Portfolio
segments.note: Newer medicines early in their lives — cancer drugs Opdivo and Opdivo Qvantig, blood treatments Reblozyl and Breyanzi (+46%), heart drug Camzyos (+42%) and others. Up 12%.

segments.name: Legacy Portfolio
segments.note: Older medicines facing generic copies. Blood thinner Eliquis grew 25% to $4.7B, offsetting steep generic declines in Revlimid (-47%) and Pomalyst (-81%).

segments.name: Other revenue
segments.note: A small negative from currency hedging activities.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Selling medicines and running the company — down 5% YoY.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Developing new medicines in the lab and in clinical trials — down 6% YoY.

opex.name: Acquired IPRD
opex.note: Upfront charges for research bought from partners — licensing deals and collaboration rights that have not yet become approved products. Up from $633M a year ago; see one-time items.

opex.name: Amortization of acquired intangible assets
opex.note: Spreading the cost of drug rights bought in past deals — down 45% YoY as Pomalyst rights finished amortizing.

otherDetail: Other expense was $307M, net: $403M of interest expense and a $187M restructuring provision, partly offset by $200M of royalty and licensing income and $118M of investment income.
footerNote: The release's rounded portfolio subtotals add to $13,070M; the Growth Portfolio is shown at $7,661M ($1M below its rounded $7,662M subtotal) so the segments tie exactly to reported total revenue of $13,069M.
oneTimers: Acquired IPRD charges of $1,558M — upfront payments for licensed and collaboration drug research. GAAP and non-GAAP EPS both include a net -$0.58 per share from these charges and licensing income.
A $187M provision for restructuring, inside other expense.
Gross margin also included a one-time charge related to a contract termination (the company did not quantify it separately), and fell from 71.9% to 68.3% mainly on product mix.

takeaways.title: Newer medicines are carrying growth
takeaways.text: The Growth Portfolio rose 12% to $7.7B — Breyanzi +46%, Camzyos +42%, Reblozyl +22% and the new under-the-skin Opdivo Qvantig — and is now about 59% of all revenue.

takeaways.title: Eliquis is doing the heavy lifting
takeaways.text: Eliquis alone brought in $4.7B, up 25% — more than the rest of the Legacy Portfolio combined — while Revlimid and Pomalyst shrank by $755M combined under generic competition.

takeaways.title: Buying future drugs cost $1.6B this quarter
takeaways.text: Acquired research charges of $1,558M cut into profit now in exchange for pipeline rights later. The company still raised full-year revenue guidance to $49.75–$50.25B, while trimming non-GAAP EPS guidance to $6.35–$6.55 because of these charges.
